_comment: Tier-2 for dealii helmholtz#1. Tier-2 for dealii helmholtz#1 — probe "complex_split_coupling" of the shared translation unit _shared/helmholtz_family.cc. This deal.II is a real-scalar build, so the complex Helmholtz problem is split into a 2-component FESystem carrying (u_re, u_im); the absorbing boundary term -i k u v dS is purely off-diagonal in that split, and omitting it leaves the two blocks independent. Mutation control: T2_MUTATE=1 assembles the coupling, and the fixture then fails its own expectations. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against deal.II 9.8.0-pre (Release at ~/dealii/build; Debug at the dbgbuild tree where the fixture sets requires_debug); every expect_in_output string was copied from that run.
